scope: Focused fictional public booking: family quote, pay-at-hotel confirmation, private-token management, date change, cancellation and reload persistence. Not full PMS acceptance.
assertions: Public portal refuses invalid management access without guest disclosure
2 adults and child age 7 receive a two-night THB 7062 accepted quote
Confirmation retains the accepted cancellation deadline
Management token is removed from URL and reload uses private session storage
Extending to three nights quotes THB 10593 and survives reload
Accepted free cancellation releases the selected stay and current payable balance becomes zero
Cancelled stay remains disabled after reload
Desktop and mobile have no horizontal overflow
remaining: Multiple rooms and partial cancellation browser matrix
Online payment/deposit/refund, signed webhook and restart browser recovery
Three properties of 200 rooms, 730 days and 20 concurrent authenticated users
